name: Pickaxe
Effect: Allows mining of ore deposits and stone walls
Description: A sturdy iron pickaxe with a worn wooden handle. Essential for any aspiring miner.

name: Reinforced Pickaxe
Effect: 50% faster mining speed, can mine mithril deposits
Description: A pickaxe reinforced with steel bands. The head gleams with an otherworldly sharpness.

name: Adamantine Pickaxe
Effect: 100% faster mining, can mine adamantite and diamond veins
Description: Forged from the hardest material known to mortal smiths. Nothing can withstand its bite.

name: Woodcutter's Axe
Effect: Allows felling of trees and gathering of lumber
Description: A single-bladed axe designed for chopping wood. The blade is sharp and well-maintained.

name: Battle Axe
Effect: Can fell ancient trees, deals 15 damage in combat
Description: A heavy double-headed axe forged for war. Its weight makes short work of even the sturdiest oaks.

name: Shovel
Effect: Allows digging for buried items and creating pits
Description: A simple iron shovel with a T-shaped handle. Indispensable for any excavation work.

name: Golden Shovel
Effect: Doubles buried treasure discovery rate, can dig in sacred ground
Description: A shovel plated in gold. The ancients believed it attracted buried riches like a magnet.

name: Fishing Rod
Effect: Allows fishing in bodies of water for fish and rare items
Description: A bamboo fishing rod with a silken line and bone hook. Patience is the only bait needed.

name: Enchanted Fishing Rod
Effect: Can catch magical fish, increases rare item drop rate by 25%
Description: The line glows with a faint blue light. Fish seem drawn to it as if by an invisible current.

name: Lantern
Effect: Illuminates dark areas, reveals hidden passages
Description: A brass lantern with crystal panes. The flame burns steadily even in the strongest wind.

name: Everburn Lantern
Effect: Never runs out of fuel, reveals invisible creatures within 10 feet
Description: The flame within burns with an ethereal blue fire that never dims. Said to be lit by a dying star.

name: Compass
Effect: Points toward the nearest quest objective
Description: A brass compass with an enchanted needle. It spins wildly near magical disturbances.

name: Wayfinder Compass
Effect: Points to any previously visited location, reveals hidden paths
Description: The needle of this compass can point to any place you have ever stood. The ultimate tool for explorers.

name: Lockpick
Effect: Allows attempt to pick locks on doors and chests
Description: A thin steel wire bent into a precise shape. Breaks occasionally under pressure.

name: Master Lockpick
Effect: 90% success rate on locks, can pick magical locks
Description: Forged by a master locksmith. The pick vibrates slightly when near the correct tumblers.

name: Hammer
Effect: Used for smithing and construction, deals 8 damage
Description: A heavy iron hammer with a leather-wrapped handle. The smith's most trusted companion.

name: Warhammer
Effect: Deals 22 damage, can shield bash, used for heavy smithing
Description: A massive hammer with a spike on the back. It can crush both ore and skulls with equal ease.

name: Saw
Effect: Allows precise cutting of wood and bone
Description: A steel hand saw with fine teeth. Cuts through wood like butter.

name: Chisel
Effect: Allows stone carving and gem cutting
Description: A narrow steel chisel used by stonemasons and jewelers alike.

name: Tongs
Effect: Allows handling of hot materials without burning
Description: A pair of iron tongs designed for gripping hot metal. Essential for any forge work.

name: Bellows
Effect: Increases forge temperature, speeds up smelting by 50%
Description: A wooden bellows with leather sides. A few good pumps can bring a dying forge back to life.

name: Mortar and Pestle
Effect: Allows grinding of herbs and creation of potions
Description: A stone mortar with a wooden pestle. The surface is stained with countless herbal preparations.

name: Magnifying Glass
Effect: Reveals hidden details on items, increases appraisal accuracy
Description: A brass-framed lens that makes the small seem grand. Useful for examining inscriptions and flaws.

name: Grappling Hook
Effect: Allows climbing walls and crossing gaps
Description: A three-pronged iron hook attached to a sturdy rope. The adventurer's shortcut.

name: Spyglass
Effect: Allows viewing distant objects, reveals enemy camps from afar
Description: A collapsible brass telescope. The lenses are ground to perfection, revealing details miles away.

name: Sextant
Effect: Allows navigation by stars, prevents getting lost at sea
Description: A navigation instrument of polished brass. Essential for any serious mariner.

name: Tool Belt
Effect: Increases tool effectiveness by 15%, allows faster tool switching
Description: A leather belt with multiple pouches and loops. Every tool has its place.

name: Whetstone
Effect: Restores 50% durability to bladed weapons
Description: A smooth rectangular stone used for sharpening blades. A sharp edge is a warrior's best friend.

name: Oil Flask
Effect: Can be lit as a thrown weapon (fire damage) or used to lubricate mechanisms
Description: A small glass flask filled with highly flammable oil. Handle with extreme care.

name: Ancient Key
Effect: Opens the sealed door in the Forgotten Temple
Description: A tarnished bronze key covered in spiraling runes. It feels warm to the touch, as if remembering the hands that once held it.

name: Royal Seal
Effect: Grants audience with the King, proves legitimacy
Description: The official seal of the Kingdom, pressed into crimson wax. Only those of noble blood may carry it.

name: Magic Artifact
Effect: Emits a pulse of arcane energy when near other artifacts
Description: A crystalline orb that shifts colors depending on the light. It hums with barely contained power.

name: Lost Tome
Effect: Contains forgotten spells, can be studied for XP
Description: A leather-bound book written in an extinct language. The pages seem to turn themselves when no one is watching.

name: Crystal Shard
Effect: One of five shards needed to repair the Crystal Crown
Description: A fragment of pure crystallized magic. When held to the ear, it whispers of ancient wars.

name: Dragon Scale
Effect: Proof of dragon slaying, required for Dragon Hunter quest
Description: A scale the size of a shield, shimmering with iridescent fire. It radiates intense heat.

name: Phoenix Feather
Effect: Can revive the dead once, required for the Resurrection Ritual
Description: A feather that glows with an inner flame. It is perpetually warm and smells of cinnamon and ash.

name: Unicorn Horn
Effect: Cures any poison, required for the Healer's Quest
Description: A spiraling horn of pearlescent white. It radiates a gentle, purifying light.

name: Demon Heart
Effect: Required to complete the Banishment Ritual
Description: A black, pulsating heart still beating with infernal energy. It must be kept in a blessed container.

name: Angel Tear
Effect: Can purify cursed items, required for the Cleansing Quest
Description: A crystalline tear that never evaporates. It glows with a soft golden light.

name: Elder Rune
Effect: Key to understanding the Elder Language, grants access to hidden libraries
Description: A flat stone inscribed with symbols that predate civilization. The symbols seem to rearrange when unobserved.

name: Sacred Relic
Effect: Required for the Temple's final trial, grants divine blessing
Description: A golden chalice encrusted with holy symbols. It is said to hold the prayers of a thousand saints.

name: Cursed Idol
Effect: Must be destroyed to lift the curse from the village
Description: A small obsidian figurine depicting a grotesque demon. It whispers dark thoughts to anyone who holds it.

name: Enchanted Compass
Effect: Points toward the hidden treasure of the Pirate King
Description: A compass with a compass rose made of real gold. The needle points to where X marks the spot.

name: Mystic Orb
Effect: Shows visions of the future, required for the Seer's Prophecy quest
Description: A perfectly smooth sphere of swirling purple mist. Gazing into it reveals fragmented visions of what may come.

name: Ancient Map
Effect: Reveals the location of the Forgotten City
Description: A parchment map drawn in faded ink. The coastlines match no known continent.

name: Forbidden Scroll
Effect: Contains a spell of ultimate power, must be delivered to the Council
Description: A scroll sealed with black wax. Reading it aloud causes reality to tremble.

name: War Banner
Effect: Rally allies in battle, required for the Siege of Blackkeep
Description: A tattered banner bearing the crest of the fallen army. It still smells of smoke and blood.

name: King's Crown
Effect: Proof of rightful succession, grants authority over the kingdom
Description: A crown of gold and sapphires. It weighs heavy, for it carries the burden of a nation.

name: Queen's Necklace
Effect: Required for the Royal Wedding quest, grants diplomatic immunity
Description: A delicate chain of platinum set with a single, perfect ruby. It was crafted for the queen's coronation.

name: Hero's Medal
Effect: Awarded for completing the Dragon's Lair quest
Description: A bronze medal struck in the likeness of a dragon's head. The symbol of true heroism.

name: Warrior Token
Effect: Required for the Champion's Trial
Description: A token given to warriors who have proven themselves in the arena. It bears the mark of the Champion.

name: Sage Staff Fragment
Effect: One of three fragments needed to restore the Sage's Staff
Description: A piece of petrified wood etched with arcane symbols. It pulses with a faint magical aura.

name: Wizard's Hat
Effect: Required for the Magician's Initiation
Description: A pointed hat of midnight blue, decorated with silver stars. It fits only the worthy.

name: Priest's Holy Symbol
Effect: Required for the Rite of Cleansing
Description: A golden sun symbol representing the Dawn God. It radiates warmth and comfort.

name: Adventurer's Journal
Effect: Contains clues to hidden treasures, can be studied for XP
Description: A leather journal filled with maps, sketches, and cryptic notes. The previous owner vanished without a trace.

name: Merchant's License
Effect: Required to open a shop, grants 10% discount at all merchants
Description: An official document stamped with the Merchant's Guild seal. It grants the right to trade within city walls.

name: Guard Badge
Effect: Grants access to restricted areas, required for the Guard Captain quest
Description: A silver badge bearing the emblem of the City Guard. It carries the weight of the law.

name: Assassin's Contract
Effect: Eliminates the target, grants a reward from the Dark Brotherhood
Description: A sealed letter containing the name and description of the target. Breaking the seal means commitment.

name: Spy Decoder
Effect: Translates encrypted messages, reveals spy networks
Description: A small brass cylinder with rotating rings. It can decode any cipher used by the spy guild.

name: Ancient Coin
Effect: Required to enter the Temple of the Ancients
Description: A coin from a civilization lost to time. It bears the face of a long-dead emperor.

name: Sealed Letter
Effect: Must be delivered to the Commander without breaking the seal
Description: A letter sealed with wax bearing the military crest. The contents are unknown.

name: Broken Sword
Effect: Can be reforged into a legendary weapon at the right smithy
Description: The shattered remains of a once-great blade. The metal still gleams with an inner light.

name: Mysterious Map
Effect: Changes with each viewing, reveals different locations
Description: A map drawn on dragonhide. The ink shifts and swirls, drawing new paths with each glance.

name: Blood Oath Vial
Effect: Binds the drinker to a blood oath, cannot be broken
Description: A small vial of crimson liquid. It glows with a faint inner light and pulses like a heartbeat.

name: Forgotten Relic
Effect: Emits a beacon of light when near other relics
Description: A stone tablet covered in worn carvings. It feels impossibly heavy for its size.

name: Iron Ore
Effect: Used in basic smithing, can be smelted into iron ingots
Description: A chunk of reddish-brown rock with visible metallic veins. The backbone of any forge.

name: Copper Ore
Effect: Used in electrical components and alloys, smelts into copper ingots
Description: A greenish rock streaked with orange metal. One of the first ores mastered by mortals.

name: Tin Ore
Effect: Used in bronze alloys, smelts into tin ingots
Description: A silvery-grey ore found in sedimentary rock. When mixed with copper, it creates bronze.

name: Silver Ore
Effect: Used in anti-undead weapons and jewelry, smelts into silver ingots
Description: A gleaming white ore that seems to glow in moonlight. Particularly effective against the undead.

name: Gold Ore
Effect: Used in high-tier crafting and currency, smelts into gold ingots
Description: A nugget of pure yellow gold embedded in quartz. The prize of any miner's haul.

name: Mithril Ore
Effect: Used in legendary weapon crafting, extremely lightweight and strong
Description: A bluish-silver ore that feels lighter than air. Said to be mined from the bones of sleeping dragons.

name: Adamantite Ore
Effect: Used in the finest weapons and armor, harder than steel
Description: A dark green ore that sparkles with golden flecks. It can only be smelted in dragonfire.

name: Coal
Effect: Fuel for forges and smelting, burns hot and long
Description: A black, combustible rock. The lifeblood of any forge.

name: Leather
Effect: Used in light armor and accessory crafting
Description: Tanned animal hide, supple and strong. A versatile material for any craftsman.

name: Hardened Leather
Effect: Used in medium armor, offers better protection than regular leather
Description: Leather treated with alchemical solutions. It is stiff yet surprisingly flexible.

name: Cloth
Effect: Used in robes and light armor crafting
Description: A bolt of plain woven fabric. Simple but essential for any tailor.

name: Silk
Effect: Used in magic robes, offers better mana regeneration
Description: A shimmering fabric spun by giant spiders. It is light as air yet stronger than steel.

name: Wool
Effect: Used in warm clothing and padding
Description: Thick, curly fleece from mountain sheep. Perfect for cold climates.

name: Hemp
Effect: Used in rope and rough clothing
Description: Strong plant fibers twisted into粗 cordage. Indispensable for ropes and bindings.

name: Flax
Effect: Used in linen and fine cloth
Description: Slender stalks with blue flowers. The fibers within make a soft, durable fabric.

name: Cotton
Effect: Used in comfortable clothing and bandages
Description: Fluffy white bolls from the cotton plant. Soft and absorbent.

name: Rubber
Effect: Used in waterproof gear and elastic components
Description: A sticky substance harvested from jungle trees. It bounces when dropped.

name: Glass
Effect: Used in potions, optics, and fragile components
Description: Transparent silica shaped by fire. Useful for vials, lenses, and decorative items.

name: Crystal
Effect: Used in magical items and focuses, amplifies spell power
Description: A naturally formed crystal that resonates with magical energy. It hums when touched.

name: Diamond
Effect: Used in highest-tier crafting, can cut any material
Description: A perfectly formed crystal of pure carbon. It is the hardest substance known to mortal kind.

name: Ruby
Effect: Used in fire-imbued weapons and jewelry
Description: A deep red gemstone that glows like a smoldering ember. Said to contain the heart of a fire elemental.

name: Sapphire
Effect: Used in ice-imbued weapons and jewelry
Description: A deep blue gemstone that chills the air around it. Said to contain a frozen tear of the moon.

name: Emerald
Effect: Used in nature-imbued items and healing jewelry
Description: A vibrant green gemstone that pulses with life energy. The Fey consider it sacred.

name: Amethyst
Effect: Used in magic-resistant items and warding jewelry
Description: A purple crystal known to repel dark magic. Worn by mages to protect against curses.

name: Topaz
Effect: Used in lightning-imbued weapons and speed jewelry
Description: A golden gemstone that crackles with static energy. It is favored by lightning mages.

name: Pearl
Effect: Used in water-imbued items and charm jewelry
Description: A lustrous sphere formed within an oyster. It glows softly in the dark.

name: Coral
Effect: Used in sea-themed items and breathing enchantments
Description: Branches of pink and red harvested from the ocean floor. It retains a faint saltwater scent.

name: Amber
Effect: Used in preservation items and insect-themed jewelry
Description: Fossilized tree resin with ancient insects trapped inside. Warm to the touch.

name: Jade
Effect: Used in eastern-themed items and chi-imbued weapons
Description: A smooth green stone prized by eastern monks. It is said to bring balance to the spirit.

name: Obsidian
Effect: Used in dark magic items and razor-sharp blades
Description: Volcanic glass that can hold an edge sharper than steel. Prized by shadow assassins.

name: Marble
Effect: Used in construction and sacred items
Description: A smooth white stone used in the construction of temples and palaces. It echoes with ancient prayers.

name: Granite
Effect: Used in fortifications and heavy construction
Description: A hard, speckled stone that can withstand centuries. The foundation of any castle.

name: Sandstone
Effect: Used in desert architecture and heat-resistant items
Description: A warm, grainy stone found in desert regions. It holds heat during the night.

name: Clay
Effect: Used in pottery and brick making
Description: Wet, malleable earth perfect for shaping. It hardens when fired in a kiln.

name: Bone
Effect: Used in necromantic items and bone weapons
Description: Bleached skeletal remains. Used by necromancers and artisans alike.

name: Dragon Bone
Effect: Used in legendary weapon crafting, radiates elemental energy
Description: A bone fragment from an ancient dragon. It is harder than steel and hums with power.

name: Phoenix Ash
Effect: Used in resurrection items and fire potions
Description: Fine grey ash that never cools. It can bring the dead back to life when mixed properly.

name: Fairy Dust
Effect: Used in enchantments and invisibility potions
Description: Sparkling motes that float when released. It smells of wildflowers and old magic.

name: Moonstone
Effect: Used in lunar-imbued items, glows under moonlight
Description: A pale stone that glows under the full moon. It is sacred to the Moon Goddess.

name: Sunstone
Effect: Used in solar-imbued items, glows in daylight
Description: A warm, golden stone that radiates light even in darkness. It is sacred to the Sun God.

name: Starstone
Effect: Used in cosmic-imbued items, enhances star magic
Description: A stone that fell from the heavens. It contains the light of a dying star.

name: Shadow Essence
Effect: Used in shadow magic and dark enchantments
Description: A vial of liquid darkness. It writhes and shifts like a living thing.

name: Divine Essence
Effect: Used in holy items and celestial enchantments
Description: A vial of pure radiant energy. It burns the unholy and heals the righteous.

name: Void Crystal
Effect: Used in space-time magic and dimensional items
Description: A crystal that contains a fragment of the void between worlds. It defies the laws of physics.

name: Living Steel
Effect: Used in self-repairing weapons and armor
Description: Steel infused with elemental spirit. It repairs itself when damaged, given enough time.

name: Bloodstone
Effect: Used in blood magic and vampiric items
Description: A dark red stone that seems to pulse with a heartbeat. It is favored by vampires.

name: Soul Gem
Effect: Captures enemy souls, used in soul-based enchantments
Description: A faceted gemstone that traps the essence of dying creatures. It glows brighter with each soul captured.

name: Copper Coin
Effect: Standard low-value currency
Description: A small, dull coin stamped with the image of a wheat sheaf. The everyday currency of the common folk.

name: Silver Coin
Effect: Medium-value currency, 100 copper = 1 silver
Description: A bright coin bearing the profile of a long-dead king. Worth a day's wages for a commoner.

name: Gold Coin
Effect: High-value currency, 100 silver = 1 gold
Description: A gleaming coin stamped with a dragon. It can buy a horse or a small farm.

name: Platinum Coin
Effect: Premium currency, 100 gold = 1 platinum
Description: A heavy, silvery coin with an intricate design. It can buy a manor or an army.

name: Diamond Token
Effect: Trading token accepted by all merchant guilds
Description: A crystalline token that refracts light into rainbows. Accepted by every guild hall in the realm.

name: Ruby Token
Effect: Trading token used in the Underdark markets
Description: A deep red token that pulses with warmth. The preferred currency of the Dwarven merchants.

name: Sapphire Token
Effect: Trading token used in elven territories
Description: A deep blue token that chills the air. The elves accept it as a sign of good faith.

name: Emerald Token
Effect: Trading token used in the Feywild
Description: A vibrant green token that smells of wildflowers. The Fey trade in these exclusively.

name: Amethyst Token
Effect: Trading token used by the Mage's Council
Description: A purple token that hums with arcane energy. It is the only currency accepted at the Arcane Academy.

name: Ancient Coin
Effect: Can be exchanged at the Museum for rare artifacts
Description: A coin from a lost civilization. The Museum pays handsomely for these relics.

name: Royal Coin
Effect: Minted by the crown, required for royal transactions
Description: A gold coin bearing the royal seal. Only these coins are accepted in the castle treasury.

name: Merchant Token
Effect: Earned through trade, gives 5% discount at shops
Description: A brass token with the merchant's guild insignia. Frequent traders accumulate these.

name: Guild Token
Effect: Earned through guild quests, buys guild-exclusive items
Description: A silver token stamped with the guild's crest. Each guild has its own unique design.

name: Adventurer's Token
Effect: Earned through dungeon clears, buys adventurer supplies
Description: A bronze token with a sword and shield motif. The mark of a seasoned adventurer.

name: Battle Token
Effect: Earned through PvP, buys arena equipment
Description: A blood-red token stained with the sweat of the arena. Only the strongest earn these.

name: Victory Token
Effect: Earned through winning tournaments, buys champion gear
Description: A golden token emblazoned with a laurel wreath. A symbol of tournament supremacy.

name: Champion Token
Effect: Earned through championship wins, buys legendary items
Description: A platinum token with a diamond inlay. Only true champions possess these.

name: Hero Token
Effect: Earned through heroic deeds, buys hero-exclusive items
Description: A mithril token that glows with inner light. Given only to those who save entire kingdoms.

name: Legend Token
Effect: Earned through legendary quests, buys mythic items
Description: A starstone token that defies gravity. It floats in your palm and whispers of destiny.

name: Mythic Token
Effect: Earned through impossible feats, buys artifacts
Description: A token forged from the heart of a dying star. It is said that only five exist in all the realms.

name: Divine Token
Effect: Gift from the gods, can reshape reality
Description: A token given by the gods themselves. It contains the power to create or destroy worlds.

name: Iron Key
Effect: Opens basic iron locks
Description: A simple iron key with a round bow. It opens the most common locks found in dungeons.

name: Rusty Key
Effect: Opens old, corroded locks in abandoned buildings
Description: A corroded key covered in orange rust. It may break if used too often.

name: Copper Key
Effect: Opens copper locks, required for some puzzle doors
Description: A greenish copper key with a four-leaf clover design. Lucky to find, luckier to use.

name: Brass Key
Effect: Opens brass locks, common in merchant shops
Description: A polished brass key with an ornate handle. It feels heavier than it looks.

name: Silver Key
Effect: Opens silver locks, required for enchanted doors
Description: A gleaming silver key that shines even in darkness. It feels cool to the touch.

name: Gold Key
Effect: Opens gold locks, required for treasure vaults
Description: A solid gold key with a royal crest. It unlocks the doors to unimaginable wealth.

name: Mithril Key
Effect: Opens mithril locks, required for ancient vaults
Description: A key forged from mithril, lighter than air but impossible to break.

name: Crystal Key
Effect: Opens crystal locks, required for magical barriers
Description: A key carved from a single crystal. It glows with a soft, pulsing light.

name: Diamond Key
Effect: Opens diamond locks, required for the most secure vaults
Description: A key carved from pure diamond. It is said to be unbreakable and eternal.

name: Skeleton Key
Effect: Opens any mechanical lock regardless of complexity
Description: A master key that can bypass any non-magical lock. The locksmith's ultimate creation.

name: Master Key
Effect: Opens all doors in a specific dungeon
Description: A key that opens every door within a particular dungeon. It is keyed to the dungeon's original master.

name: Prison Key
Effect: Opens all prison cells in the jail
Description: A heavy iron key with a red ribbon. It opens every cell in the dungeon.

name: Dungeon Key
Effect: Opens the entrance gate to the dungeon
Description: A worn iron key that unlocks the main gate to the dungeon. Each dungeon has its own unique key.

name: Treasury Key
Effect: Opens the treasury vault
Description: A golden key with an intricate mechanism. It guards the kingdom's wealth.

name: Vault Key
Effect: Opens a merchant's private vault
Description: A brass key with the merchant's guild seal. It opens the most secure vaults.

name: Temple Key
Effect: Opens the inner sanctum of the temple
Description: A holy key blessed by the high priest. It only opens for those pure of heart.

name: Castle Key
Effect: Opens the main gate of the castle
Description: A massive iron key bearing the castle's crest. It is carried only by the gatekeeper.

name: Tower Key
Effect: Opens the wizard's tower entrance
Description: A key carved from petrified wood. It glows faintly with arcane energy.

name: Crypt Key
Effect: Opens the sealed crypt entrance
Description: A tarnished bronze key cold to the touch. It was buried with the crypt's keeper.

name: Royal Key
Effect: Opens the royal chambers and forbidden archives
Description: A golden key with the royal seal. It grants access to the kingdom's deepest secrets.

name: Enchanted Key
Effect: Opens magical locks, glows near hidden doors
Description: A key that shifts shape to fit any magical lock. It hums with a soft, inviting tune.

name: Shadow Key
Effect: Opens doors between the material plane and the Shadowfell
Description: A key forged from solidified shadow. It exists only when not being observed.

name: Void Key
Effect: Opens rifts to the Void dimension
Description: A key that seems to absorb light. It is said to unlock the gates between worlds.

name: Scroll of Fireball
Effect: Casts a fireball dealing 50 fire damage in a 10-foot radius
Description: A parchment scroll that radiates warmth. The ink glows red hot as the spell activates.

name: Scroll of Healing
Effect: Restores 100 health points to the reader
Description: A white scroll that feels warm and comforting. Reading it aloud fills the body with vitality.

name: Scroll of Teleport
Effect: Teleports the reader to a previously visited location
Description: A blue scroll that shimmers like heat haze. The reader vanishes in a flash of light.

name: Scroll of Shield
Effect: Creates a magical barrier that absorbs 80 damage
Description: A white scroll covered in protective runes. Reading it creates an invisible barrier.

name: Scroll of Strength
Effect: Increases physical damage by 25% for 5 minutes
Description: A red scroll that pulses with raw power. The reader's muscles swell with temporary might.

name: Scroll of Speed
Effect: Increases movement speed by 50% for 5 minutes
Description: A yellow scroll that crackles with lightning. The reader's limbs blur with incredible speed.

name: Scroll of Invisibility
Effect: Grants invisibility for 3 minutes or until attacking
Description: A transparent scroll that is nearly impossible to see. Reading it makes the reader vanish from sight.

name: Scroll of Identify
Effect: Reveals all properties and enchantments of one item
Description: A blue scroll with an all-seeing eye drawn upon it. Reading it reveals hidden truths.

name: Scroll of Dispel
Effect: Removes all magical effects from the target
Description: A silver scroll covered in dispelling sigils. Reading it unravels any enchantment.

name: Scroll of Resurrection
Effect: Brings a dead ally back to life with 50% health
Description: A golden scroll that glows with divine light. Reading it calls the soul back from the afterlife.

name: Scroll of Time Stop
Effect: Freezes time for 10 seconds, allowing free movement
Description: A prismatic scroll that shifts through all colors. Reading it causes the world to freeze.

name: Scroll of Magic Missile
Effect: Fires 3 homing projectiles dealing 15 force damage each
Description: A simple scroll with a pointing hand drawn upon it. Reading it launches glowing bolts.

name: Scroll of Lightning Bolt
Effect: Shoots a bolt of lightning dealing 60 lightning damage
Description: A yellow scroll that crackles with static. Reading it releases a blinding bolt of electricity.

name: Scroll of Ice Storm
Effect: Creates a blizzard dealing 40 ice damage and slowing enemies
Description: A blue scroll covered in snowflake patterns. Reading it summons a freezing tempest.

name: Scroll of Fire Wall
Effect: Creates a wall of fire that burns enemies for 30 damage per second
Description: A red scroll with a flame motif. Reading it conjures a barrier of roaring flames.

name: Scroll of Summon
Effect: Summons a random creature to fight for 2 minutes
Description: A purple scroll with an open portal drawn upon it. Reading it tears open a rift in reality.

name: Scroll of Charm
Effect: Charms a humanoid enemy, making them friendly for 1 minute
Description: A pink scroll with a heart design. Reading it fills the target with adoration.

name: Scroll of Sleep
Effect: Puts all enemies in range to sleep for 30 seconds
Description: A lavender scroll with a crescent moon. Reading it releases a wave of drowsiness.

name: Scroll of Confusion
Effect: Confuses enemies, causing them to attack randomly for 20 seconds
Description: A multicolored scroll that seems to shift and blur. Reading it scrambles the mind.

name: Scroll of Fear
Effect: Causes enemies to flee in terror for 15 seconds
Description: A black scroll with a screaming face. Reading it fills all who hear it with primal dread.

name: Scroll of Courage
Effect: Grants immunity to fear and increases morale for 5 minutes
Description: A golden scroll with a lion emblem. Reading it fills the heart with unwavering bravery.

name: Scroll of Wisdom
Effect: Increases spell power by 20% for 5 minutes
Description: A blue scroll with an owl symbol. Reading it sharpens the mind and expands the spirit.

name: Scroll of Luck
Effect: Increases item drop rate by 30% for 10 minutes
Description: A green scroll with a four-leaf clover. Reading it bends fate in the reader's favor.

name: Scroll of Fortune
Effect: Transmutes 100 copper into 10 gold
Description: A golden scroll that glitters. Reading it performs alchemy on currency itself.

name: Scroll of Protection
Effect: Grants a permanent +1 to all defenses (one-time use)
Description: A white scroll inscribed with protective wards. Reading it permanently fortifies the soul.

name: Scroll of Warding
Effect: Creates a magical ward that repels undead for 24 hours
Description: A silver scroll with holy symbols. Reading it creates an invisible barrier against the dead.

name: Scroll of Banishment
Effect: Sends an extraplanar creature back to its home plane
Description: A scroll of pure white parchment. Reading it tears open a portal to send creatures home.

name: Scroll of Binding
Effect: Binds a creature to a vessel, creating a familiar
Description: A scroll covered in binding runes. Reading it forces a spirit into servitude.

name: Scroll of Opening
Effect: Opens any non-magical door or lock
Description: A simple scroll with a key symbol. Reading it causes any mundane lock to click open.

name: Scroll of Comprehension
Effect: Allows the reader to read and speak any language for 1 hour
Description: A scroll written in every known language. Reading it unlocks the gift of tongues.

name: Scroll of Levitation
Effect: Allows the reader to float in the air for 5 minutes
Description: A light blue scroll that floats when released. Reading it grants the gift of flight.

name: Scroll of Tremorsense
Effect: Allows the reader to detect creatures through walls for 10 minutes
Description: A brown scroll with wave patterns. Reading it grants the ability to feel vibrations.

name: Fire Rune
Effect: Adds fire damage to weapons, 10% chance to ignite
Description: A stone tablet carved with a flame symbol. It radiates heat when touched.

name: Ice Rune
Effect: Adds ice damage to weapons, 10% chance to slow
Description: A stone tablet carved with a snowflake symbol. Frost forms on its surface.

name: Lightning Rune
Effect: Adds lightning damage to weapons, 10% chance to stun
Description: A stone tablet carved with a lightning bolt symbol. It crackles with static energy.

name: Earth Rune
Effect: Adds earth damage to weapons, increases armor by 5%
Description: A stone tablet carved with a mountain symbol. It feels incredibly heavy.

name: Wind Rune
Effect: Adds wind damage to weapons, increases attack speed by 10%
Description: A stone tablet carved with a spiral symbol. It hums with a gentle breeze.

name: Water Rune
Effect: Adds water damage to weapons, heals 2% HP per hit
Description: A stone tablet carved with a wave symbol. It is always damp to the touch.

name: Light Rune
Effect: Adds holy damage to weapons, effective against undead
Description: A stone tablet carved with a sun symbol. It glows with a warm, golden light.

name: Dark Rune
Effect: Adds shadow damage to weapons, 15% chance to fear
Description: A stone tablet carved with an eclipse symbol. It seems to absorb light.

name: Life Rune
Effect: Increases maximum HP by 5%, heals 1% HP per second
Description: A stone tablet carved with a tree symbol. It pulses with vital energy.

name: Death Rune
Effect: Adds necrotic damage to weapons, 5% chance to instant kill
Description: A stone tablet carved with a skull symbol. It emanates an aura of dread.

name: Time Rune
Effect: 10% chance to reset cooldowns on hit
Description: A stone tablet carved with an hourglass symbol. Time seems to slow around it.

name: Space Rune
Effect: 15% chance to teleport behind the enemy on hit
Description: A stone tablet carved with a portal symbol. It warps space in its vicinity.

name: Mind Rune
Effect: Increases spell power by 10%, reduces mana cost by 5%
Description: A stone tablet carved with an eye symbol. It radiates psychic energy.

name: Soul Rune
Effect: Absorbs 5% of damage dealt as mana
Description: A stone tablet carved with a spirit symbol. It whispers promises of power.

name: Blood Rune
Effect: Sacrifice 5% HP to deal 20% more damage
Description: A stone tablet carved with a drop symbol. It is stained permanently red.

name: Shadow Rune
Effect: Increases stealth effectiveness by 25%
Description: A stone tablet carved with a crescent moon symbol. It seems to exist in two places at once.

name: Holy Rune
Effect: Increases healing power by 15%, repels undead
Description: A stone tablet carved with a cross symbol. It radiates pure, divine light.

name: Chaos Rune
Effect: Random elemental effect on each hit
Description: A stone tablet carved with a swirling symbol. Its effects are completely unpredictable.

name: Order Rune
Effect: Stabilizes all stats, removes random effects
Description: A stone tablet carved with a geometric symbol. It brings perfect balance to all things.

name: Void Rune
Effect: 5% chance to banish enemies to the void on hit
Description: A stone tablet that appears to be a hole in reality. Looking at it causes vertigo.

name: Eternal Rune
Effect: Makes the weapon indestructible, never needs repair
Description: A stone tablet carved with an infinity symbol. It defies the natural decay of all things.

name: Primordial Rune
Effect: Adds all elemental damage types, 5% chance for each effect
Description: A stone tablet carved with all elemental symbols. It contains the power of creation itself.

name: Torch
Effect: Illuminates a 10-foot radius, burns for 1 hour
Description: A wooden stick wrapped in oiled rags. The most basic source of light.

name: Rope
Effect: Allows climbing, can tie up enemies, creates bridges
Description: 50 feet of sturdy hempen rope. Indispensable for any adventurer.

name: Bucket
Effect: Can carry water, collect blood, or hold gathered materials
Description: A wooden bucket with iron bands. Simple but surprisingly useful.

name: Bandage
Effect: Heals 20 health over 10 seconds, stops bleeding
Description: A strip of clean linen. Essential for field medicine.

name: Wine Flask
Effect: Restores 30 health, grants temporary charisma boost
Description: A leather flask filled with fine red wine. Liquid courage for the brave.

name: Bread
Effect: Restores 15 health, eliminates hunger for 4 hours
Description: A fresh loaf of brown bread. The staple food of every traveler.

name: Cheese
Effect: Restores 25 health, eliminates hunger for 6 hours
Description: A wheel of aged cheddar. It smells strong but tastes delicious.

name: Dried Meat
Effect: Restores 35 health, eliminates hunger for 8 hours
Description: Strips of salted, dried beef. A reliable source of protein on long journeys.

name: Waterskin
Effect: Holds 1 quart of water, prevents dehydration
Description: A leather waterskin that holds fresh water. Essential for desert travel.

name: Blanket
Effect: Grants rest bonuses, provides cold resistance
Description: A thick wool blanket. It keeps you warm on cold nights.

name: Tent
Effect: Allows camping anywhere, grants full rest bonuses
Description: A canvas tent with wooden poles. Your home away from home.

name: Campfire Kit
Effect: Allows building a campfire for cooking and warmth
Description: A kit containing flint, steel, and kindling. The heart of any campsite.

name: Cooking Pot
Effect: Allows cooking of raw ingredients into meals
Description: A large iron pot. Essential for preparing hot meals on the road.

name: Hunting Knife
Effect: Allows skinning of animals, deals 8 damage
Description: A sharp, curved blade. Used for skinning game and preparing meat.

name: Quill
Effect: Used for writing, crafting scrolls, and signing contracts
Description: A feather from a hawk, shaped into a writing instrument. The scribe's tool of choice.

name: Ink Bottle
Effect: Used for writing and crafting scrolls
Description: A small glass bottle filled with black ink. It never seems to run dry.

name: Parchment
Effect: Used for writing, crafting scrolls, and creating maps
Description: A sheet of prepared animal skin. The surface for all important documents.

name: Wax Seal
Effect: Used to seal letters and authenticate documents
Description: A stick of red sealing wax. It bears the imprint of the user's signet ring.

name: Candle
Effect: Provides dim light for 4 hours, used in rituals
Description: A beeswax candle that burns with a steady flame. Used in ceremonies and prayers.

name: Oil Lamp
Effect: Provides bright light for 8 hours, can be carried
Description: A brass oil lamp with a glass chimney. It provides reliable, long-lasting light.

name: Mirror
Effect: Can reflect gaze attacks, used in divination
Description: A polished silver mirror. It shows not just your reflection, but your true self.

name: Perfume
Effect: Increases charisma by 2 for 30 minutes
Description: A bottle of exotic perfume. A few drops make you irresistible.

name: Soap
Effect: Removes disease and poison effects
Description: A bar of lye soap. Cleanliness is next to godliness.

name: Comb
Effect: Grooms appearance, minor charisma boost
Description: A bone comb with fine teeth. It keeps your hair in perfect order.

name: Hairpin
Effect: Can be used as a lockpick, minor stealth bonus
Description: A slender metal pin. Useful for more than just hair.

name: Ribbon
Effect: Decorative item, minor charisma bonus
Description: A length of colorful silk ribbon. It adds a touch of elegance to any outfit.

name: Button
Effect: Used in tailoring, can be collected for crafting
Description: A small button made of bone, wood, or metal. The tailor's bread and butter.

name: Lucky Charm
Effect: Increases critical hit chance by 2%
Description: A rabbit's foot painted gold. It feels warm and tingly in your pocket.

name: Bird Whistle
Effect: Summons a bird companion for scouting
Description: A small wooden whistle carved like a bird. Blowing it attracts feathered friends.

name: Smoke Bomb
Effect: Creates a cloud of smoke, allows escape from combat
Description: A small clay sphere filled with alchemical smoke. It explodes on impact.

name: Flash Powder
Effect: Blinds all enemies in range for 5 seconds
Description: A pouch of bright alchemical powder. It creates a blinding flash when thrown.

name: Glue Pot
Effect: Used in crafting, can repair broken items
Description: A small pot of strong adhesive. It can mend almost anything.

name: Magnifying Lens
Effect: Reveals hidden inscriptions and details
Description: A detachable lens for examining small details. It reveals what the naked eye misses.

name: Spyglass (Small)
Effect: Allows viewing of distant objects, 2x zoom
Description: A small, pocket-sized telescope. Useful for scouting ahead.

name: Signal Flare
Effect: Signals allies, reveals position on map
Description: A red flare that shoots into the sky. It burns bright and long.

name: Grappling Hook (Small)
Effect: Allows climbing short walls, max 15 feet
Description: A small iron hook with a short rope. Good for quick ascents.

name: Spyglass (Enchanted)
Effect: 10x zoom, reveals invisible creatures, works through walls
Description: A telescope infused with seeing magic. Nothing can hide from its gaze.

name: Lucky Coin
Effect: Flipping it before combat grants 5% damage boost
Description: A gold coin with two heads. It always lands on heads.

name: Compass (Broken)
Effect: Points to the nearest dungeon entrance
Description: A broken compass that always points down. It seems to sense underground passages.

name: Map Fragment
Effect: One piece of a treasure map, collect all 4 for the full map
Description: A torn piece of parchment with a partial drawing. Three other pieces are missing.

name: Mysterious Bottle
Effect: Unknown effect when opened, could be anything
Description: A sealed bottle with a message inside. You never know what you'll find.

name: Treasure Chest Key (Small)
Effect: Opens small treasure chests
Description: A small brass key designed for treasure chests. Found near locked containers.

name: Golden Apple
Effect: Restores full health and mana, grants 1-hour buff
Description: An apple made of pure gold. It never spoils and radiates magical energy.

name: Phoenix Down
Effect: Revives a fallen ally with 25% health
Description: A feather from a phoenix. It glows with warm, healing light.

name: Elixir of Life
Effect: Grants immunity to all damage for 10 seconds
Description: A vial of shimmering liquid. It is said to grant temporary immortality.

name: Bottled Lightning
Effect: When thrown, deals 100 lightning damage in area
Description: A glass bottle containing a swirling storm. Handle with extreme care.

name: Shadow Essence Vial
Effect: Grants invisibility for 30 seconds when consumed
Description: A vial filled with liquid shadow. It seems to absorb all light around it.

name: Bottled Starlight
Effect: Provides permanent light source when placed
Description: A jar filled with captured starlight. It glows with a soft, warm light.

name: Dragon Scale Shield Fragment
Effect: One of 5 fragments needed to craft a Dragon Scale Shield
Description: A fragment of a dragon scale large enough to be shaped into armor.

name: Moonwell Water
Effect: Removes all curses and debuffs when consumed
Description: Water from a sacred moonwell. It glows with a soft, silvery light.

name: Fairy Dust Vial
Effect: Sprinkling it grants 30 seconds of flight
Description: A vial of sparkling fairy dust. It floats upward when released.

name: Philosopher's Stone Fragment
Effect: Transmutes 10 iron into 1 gold when held during smelting
Description: A fragment of the legendary Philosopher's Stone. It glows with an inner fire.

name: Time Crystal
Effect: Reverses time by 10 seconds once per day
Description: A crystal that contains a fragment of frozen time. It pulses with temporal energy.

name: Bag of Holding
Effect: Increases inventory capacity by 100 slots
Description: A small bag that contains a vast extradimensional space. It weighs nothing regardless of contents.

name: Portable Hole
Effect: Creates a portal to a hidden pocket dimension
Description: A circular piece of cloth that, when spread flat, creates a hole into subspace.

name: Decanter of Endless Water
Effect: Provides unlimited fresh water
Description: A small stoppered flask that produces an endless stream of fresh water.

name: Gem of Seeing
Effect: Grants true sight for 10 minutes, reveals illusions
Description: A gem that grants the ability to see through all illusions and disguises.

name: Robe of Useful Items
Effect: Contains hidden pockets with random useful items
Description: An unassuming robe with many hidden pockets. You never know what you'll find.

name: Cloak of Invisibility
Effect: Grants invisibility while worn
Description: A cloak that shifts and changes to match its surroundings. It makes the wearer invisible.

name: Boots of Speed
Effect: Doubles movement speed while worn
Description: Boots that blur with speed when worn. The wearer leaves afterimages behind.

name: Gloves of Thievery
Effect: +15% to lockpicking and pickpocketing success
Description: Soft leather gloves that enhance dexterity and silence movement.

name: Amulet of Health
Effect: Increases maximum HP by 20%
Description: A golden amulet set with a ruby. It pulses with vital energy.

name: Ring of Protection
Effect: Increases all defenses by 10%
Description: A silver ring inscribed with protective runes. It hums with defensive magic.

name: Belt of Giant Strength
Effect: Increases physical damage by 25%
Description: A thick leather belt that magically enhances the wearer's strength.

name: Circlet of Blasting
Effect: Allows casting of Fireball once per day without a scroll
Description: A golden circlet with a ruby in the center. It glows when the Fireball ability is ready.

name: Staff of the Magi
Effect: Doubles spell power, regenerates mana 50% faster
Description: A staff of pure mithril topped with a crystal orb. It crackles with arcane energy.

name: Vorpal Sword
Effect: 10% chance to decapitate on critical hit
Description: A sentient blade that whispers of blood and battle. It can cut through anything.

name: Deck of Many Things
Effect: Drawing a card grants a random powerful effect (good or bad)
Description: A deck of ornate cards, each containing a different fate. The risk is as great as the reward.
